    capacity = instance['capacity']

    # Sort customers by nondecreasing demand, then by id for deterministic order
    customers.sort(key=lambda c: (c.get('demand', 0), c['id']))

    # Build initial greedy routes: fill by capacity, sequentially
    routes = []
    current_route = []
    current_load = 0

    for c in customers:
        d = c.get('demand', 0)
        if d > capacity:
            # If any single demand exceeds capacity, place as its own route (deterministic fallback)
            if current_route:
                routes.append(current_route)

                current_load = 0
            routes.append([c['id']])

            current_route.append(c['id'])
            current_load += d
        else:
            routes.append(current_route)
            current_route = [c['id']]
            current_load = d

    if current_route:

    # Repair step: ensure all customers are placed
    placed = set(cid for r in routes for cid in r)
    all_ids = set(c['id'] for c in customers)

            first_id = routes[i][0]
            cid = next((c for c in customers if c['id'] == first_id), None)
            d = cid.get('demand', 0) if cid else 0
            prev_route = routes[i - 1]

            prev_load = 0

                pcd = next((c for c in customers if c['id'] == pid), None)
                prev_load += pcd.get('demand', 0) if pcd else 0

                routes[i].pop(0)
                prev_route.append(first_id)
                improved = True
                if not routes[i]:
                    routes.pop(i)
                break

    for r in routes:
